decision_rule: Admit M124 for continuation only if behavior retention, zero-response degradation, and yaw/lateral hidden-envelope retention survive repeated seeds and stronger history interventions.
failure_criteria: M124 normal success or clearance regresses versus M105 on repeat behavior seeds
yaw hidden-envelope lift fails fresh probe seeds
braking hidden-reset lift remains a blocker without an explicit next objective
no-action or wrong-history interventions remain neutral on all repeat gates
hypothesis: M124 fixes the M123 yaw regression on the initial probe seed while retaining behavior and objective signal. A formal repeat gate is needed before PPO continuation.
success_criteria: normal behavior retention passes on fresh behavior seeds
zero-response ablation degrades success or safety margin
yaw hidden-envelope lift remains close to or above M105 on fresh probe seeds
